worlds_page.shrink_intro: هذا الإجراء يزيل أجزاء من {{world}} التي نادراً ما تواجد فيها اللاعبون لتوفير المساحة. سيعيد Minecraft بناء المنطقة المحذوفة عند السفر إليها مجدداً.

worlds_page.shrink_visited_under: إزالة المناطق التي تمت زيارتها أقل من

worlds_page.custom_seed_help: الأرقام والنصوص كلاهما مدعوم. يقوم Minecraft بتحويل النصوص إلى أرقام.
worlds_page.level_type_help: المزيد من خيارات التوليد توجد في الإعدادات ← العالم.

server_settings.name_help: يمكنك تغييره بحرية. المجلدات والحاوية والسجل تظل مرتبطة بالمعرف الداخلي.
server_settings.desc_help: يدعم تنسيق Markdown؛ يُعرض في تبويب نظرة عامة.
server_settings.notes_placeholder: لوحة ملاحظات، لا تظهر للمشاهدين أبداً

server_settings.java_heap_help: مقدار الذاكرة العشوائية التي يمكن لماينكرافت استخدامها.
server_settings.container_memory_help: الحد الأقصى الصارم الذي يفرضه دوكر على الخادم. إذا وصل إليه، يتوقف الخادم بسبب نفاد الذاكرة.
server_settings.cpu_limit_help: 0 تعني غير محدود. عند تحديد الحد، يتباطأ الخادم بدلاً من إيقافه.
server_settings.disk_quota_help: تفرض اللوحة هذه الحصة بنفسها لأن دوكر لا يمكنه تحديد هذا النوع من التخزين. عند التجاوز، تُحظر العمليات الإضافية، وقد يُوقف الخادم في الوضع الصارم.
server_settings.unpinned_pack_title: حزمة التعديلات هذه لا تملك إصداراً مثبتاً.
server_settings.unpinned_pack_desc: تقوم الحاوية بتنزيل أحدث إصدار عند كل تشغيل. قد يغير ذلك التعديلات أو إصدار العالم بصمت. افتح قسم حزم التعديلات وحدد الإصدار لتثبيته.
server_settings.update_policy_manual_desc: (لا يغير أي شيء، ولا يظهر شارات التحديث لهذا الخادم)
server_settings.update_policy_notify_desc: (عرض شارة عند توفر التحديثات لتقوم بتطبيقها بنفسك)
server_settings.update_policy_auto_desc: (يطبق تحديثات الحزمة بعد الفحص اليومي: نسخة احتياطية وفحص الحالة واسترجاع تلقائي عند الفشل، دون تغيير إصدار ماينكرافت)
server_settings.port_mapping_help: على سبيل المثال، UDP 19132 لـ Bedrock أو Geyser، أو TCP 8100 لـ BlueMap.
server_settings.volume_bind_help: مسارات مضيف مخصصة. تمتلك اللوحة وصولاً يعادل root عبر مقبس دوكر، لذا تحقق منها جيداً.
server_settings.rebuild_notice: يسري المفعول بعد إعادة بناء الحاوية.
server_settings.delete_server_help: يزيل الخادم من اللوحة. يتم الاحتفاظ بالملفات والنسخ الاحتياطية على القرص افتراضياً؛ حدد خيار الحذف الكامل إذا أردت إزالتها نهائياً.
server_settings.advanced_env_help: جميع متغيرات البيئة التي تدعمها صورة الخادم، مأخوذة مباشرة من توثيقها. اترك الحقل فارغاً لاستخدام القيمة الافتراضية؛ يتم تطبيق التغييرات بعد إعادة بناء الحاوية.
server_settings.delete_modal_intro: يؤدي هذا إلى إزالة الخادم من اللوحة ولكنه يحتفظ بملفاته ونسخه الاحتياطية على القرص. حدد المربع أدناه فقط إذا كنت تريد حذف تلك الملفات والنسخ الاحتياطية نهائياً.
server_settings.delete_data_checkbox: حذف ملفات الخادم والنسخ الاحتياطية نهائياً من القرص أيضاً.
server_settings.force_stop_message: يتخطى الإيقاف الإجباري عملية الإغلاق العادية، مما قد يتسبب في فقدان التغييرات غير المحفوظة. استخدم إيقاف ما لم يكن الخادم معلقاً.
server_settings.clone_intro: ينشئ نسخة من هذا الخادم مع منافذه الخاصة. يقوم بتصدير مخطط واستيراده كخادم جديد.
server_settings.export_bp_intro: يحفظ إعدادات هذا الخادم كمخطط قابل لإعادة الاستخدام في المكتبة.
server_settings.export_bp_embed: تضمين ملفات التعديلات المخصصة في الأرشيف (ملف أكبر، محمول بالكامل)
server_settings.export_bp_world: تضمين العالم النشط (قد يكون حجمه كبيراً)
server_settings.bp_exported_msg: تم حفظ المخطط {{name}} في المكتبة.
server_settings.bp_page_link: متاح أيضاً في أي وقت في صفحة المخططات.
server_settings.discard_msg: سيتم فقدان جميع التعديلات التي أجريتها منذ آخر عملية حفظ.

world_controls.title: إعدادات العالم
world_controls.pvp_help: يغير إعداد PvP للخادم بالكامل. يسري المفعول عند إعادة التشغيل القادمة.

chat_tab.title: الدردشة
chat_tab.subtitle: إرسال رسائل منسقة لجميع اللاعبين أو لاعب محدد داخل اللعبة. متاح أثناء تشغيل الخادم.
chat_tab.no_messages_running: لا توجد رسائل بعد. كل ما ترسله سيظهر هنا كما يراه اللاعبون.
chat_tab.no_messages_offline: الرسائل الأخيرة تظهر هنا. شغّل الخادم لإرسال الرسائل.
chat_tab.mode_help: المنسق يرسل نصاً ملوناً ويمكن توجيهه للاعب معين. النص العادي يرسل إذاعة بسيطة للجميع.

commands_tab.title: أوامر الدردشة المخصصة
commands_tab.description: يكتب اللاعبون كلمة تشغيل في دردشة اللعبة، وتقوم اللوحة بتنفيذ الإجراء المختار باسم ذلك اللاعب. يعمل دون الحاجة إلى تعديلات.
commands_tab.prefix_tip: حرف أو حرفان مثل ! أو . لا يمكن استخدام / المخصص لأوامر ماينكرافت.
commands_tab.offline_notice: الخادم متوقف. تم حفظ الأوامر وستعمل فور تشغيل الخادم مجدداً. زر الاختبار يتطلب تشغيل الخادم.
commands_tab.no_events: لا يوجد شيء بعد. ستظهر كل الاستخدامات هنا وفي سجل النشاطات.
commands_tab.run_now_tip: التنفيذ الآن كلاعب مسمى (يتم تجاوز فحص الصلاحيات وفترة الانتظار)
commands_tab.empty_message: أنشئ أمرك الأول. إعداد أمر {prefix}rtp مخصص للانتقال العشوائي يستغرق حوالي 20 ثانية.

history_tab.analyze_tip: تحليل تلقائي عبر mclo.gs يحدد المشكلات المعروفة وحلولها المقترحة.
history_tab.no_match: لا توجد أحداث تطابق هذه الفلاتر.
history_tab.empty_message: كل ما يحدث في هذا الخادم (التشغيل، الإيقاف، تعديل الإعدادات، النسخ الاحتياطي، والانهيارات) يُسجل هنا بالتفصيل.
history_tab.share_mclogs_tip: نشر هذا التقرير كرابط mclo.gs عام يمكن لأي شخص فتحه (يطلبه مطورو التعديلات عادةً).

inventory_tab.help_notice: تُقرأ الحقائب من بيانات الحفظ لكل لاعب. انقر على أي خانة لتعديلها.
inventory_tab.empty: لا توجد بيانات لاعبين بعد. ستظهر الحقائب بعد انضمام أول لاعب.
inventory_tab.item_search_sub: يبحث في حقائب ودروع وصناديق إندر جميع اللاعبين على هذا الخادم.
inventory_tab.search_hint: يطابق معرفات العناصر والأسماء المخصصة دون تحسس لحالة الأحرف.
inventory_tab.refresh_tip: إعادة قراءة ملف البيانات المحفوظة للاعب
inventory_tab.snapshot_tip: حفظ هذا المخزون كلقطة للمقارنة لاحقاً
inventory_tab.give_online_tip: تصفح كل عنصر على هذا الخادم ومنحه للاعب متصل

inventory_tab.clear_offline_tip: شغل الخادم لمسح العناصر دفعة واحدة، أو احذف الفتحات واحدة تلو الأخرى أدناه

player_detail.no_notes: لا توجد ملاحظات بعد. مرئية لمستخدمي لوحة التحكم فقط.

player_detail.delete_player_tip: حذف هذا اللاعب وجميع بياناته المحفوظة (حالة القائمة البيضاء/المشرف/الحظر، المخزون، الإحصائيات، الإنجازات والملاحظات)

updates_tab.title: توافق إصدارات ماينكرافت
updates_tab.description: فحص الإصدارات يستعلم من Modrinth و CurseForge لمعرفة الإصدارات التي تدعمها جميع الإضافات المثبتة.
updates_tab.empty_running_message: تظهر النتائج هنا تباعاً. يمكنك مغادرة الصفحة وسيستمر الفحص بالخلفية.
updates_tab.empty_newest_message: لا يوجد إصدار أحدث من ماينكرافت حالياً لفحصه.
updates_tab.empty_none_message: قم بإجراء فحص لمعرفة إصدارات ماينكرافت المستقبلية التي تدعمها إضافاتك.
updates_tab.scan_tooltip: الاستعلام من Modrinth و CurseForge عن كل تعديل مثبت
updates_tab.interrupted_notice: توقف فحص الإصدار الأخير قبل اكتماله، بسبب إعادة تشغيل اللوحة غالباً. تم الاحتفاظ بما تم إنجازه.
updates_tab.failed_notice: تعذر إكمال فحص الإصدار الأخير. يرجى تشغيله مجدداً والتحقق من إمكانية الوصول إلى Modrinth و CurseForge.
updates_tab.stale_notice: تغيرت التعديلات أو إصدار ماينكرافت أو محمل التعديلات منذ إنشاء هذا التقرير. أعد الفحص مجدداً.
updates_tab.unidentified_desc: لا يتعرف Modrinth أو CurseForge على هذه الملفات، لذا لا يمكن تحديد الإصدارات المتوافقة. طالما أنها مثبتة، لا يتوفر التحديث بنقرة واحدة.
updates_tab.unchecked_desc: تم التعرف عليها ولكنها تأتي من مصادر لا تنشر قائمة بالإصدارات المتوافقة. لا يمكن تخمين التوافق، لذا يُعطل التحديث بنقرة واحدة.
updates_tab.nearest_first: الأقرب أولاً. افتح لمعرفة التعديلات الجاهزة.

analytics_tab.investigation_sub: يكشف عن الاشتباه باستخدام كشف الموارد (X-ray) عبر مقارنة معدلات التنقيب.
analytics_tab.run_analysis: تشغيل التحليل لفحص معدلات اكتشاف الموارد لجميع اللاعبين.
analytics_tab.refresh_tip: إعادة قراءة ملفات الإحصائيات والسجلات الحديثة الآن
analytics_tab.stats_help: تأتي الإحصائيات من ملفات العالم وتتحدث كل 5 دقائق أثناء عمل الخادم. انقر على صف لعرض ملف اللاعب.
analytics_tab.privacy_note: تتم قراءة الدردشة والأحداث من سجل الخادم وتخزينها محلياً فقط على هذا الجهاز.
analytics_tab.no_filters_selected: لم يتم تحديد أي نوع حدث. حدد خياراً واحداً على الأقل من الفلاتر أعلاه.
analytics_tab.no_events_match: لا توجد أحداث تطابق هذا البحث.
analytics_tab.no_activity_yet: لم يتم تسجيل أي نشاط بعد. يتم تسجيل الأحداث مباشرة أثناء تشغيل الخادم.
analytics_tab.no_sessions_yet: لم يتم تسجيل أي جلسات بعد. يتم تتبع الجلسات من أحداث الانضمام والمغادرة أثناء تشغيل اللوحة.
analytics_tab.no_mining_data: لا توجد بيانات تنقيب للاعبين بعد. ستظهر الإحصائيات بمجرد انضمام اللاعبين وتنقيبهم.

metrics_tab.no_activity: لا توجد سجلات لهذا الخادم بعد.
metrics_tab.stopped_notice: يتم تحديث الأرقام المباشرة أثناء تشغيل الخادم. شغل الخادم لمراقبة الأداء.
metrics_tab.starting_notice: الخادم لا يزال قيد الإقلاع. ستبدأ الرسوم البيانية والأرقام بالتحرك بمجرد تشغيله.
metrics_tab.tps_help: 20 TPS تعني خادماً بحالة صحية جيدة. الهبوط المستمر يعني أن الخادم لا يستطيع مواكبة ما يجري في العالم.
metrics_tab.unread_crash_reports: {count} تقرير/تقارير انهيار غير مقروءة. راجع تبويب السجل.
metrics_tab.no_storage_sizes: لا توجد أحجام للمجلدات بعد. شغّل فحص التخزين من صفحة التخزين.
metrics_tab.disk_free_help: {free} مساحة خالية على القرص الذي يوجد به هذا الخادم.
metrics_tab.no_worlds_found: لم يتم العثور على عوالم بعد.
metrics_tab.live_refresh_note: تتحدث المخططات والأرقام العلوية مباشرة أثناء عمل الخادم. يتحدث كل شيء آخر عند إعادة التحميل.

map_tab.title: خريطة العالم المباشرة
map_tab.description: بنقرة واحدة يتم تثبيت BlueMap على الخادم وتضمين خريطة ثلاثية الأبعاد تفاعلية هنا.
map_tab.not_supported: لا توجد نسخة متوافقة من BlueMap لهذا النوع من الخوادم.
map_tab.background_note: يقوم BlueMap بالرندرة في الخلفية. تستغرق الخريطة المفعلة حديثاً بضع دقائق لرسم المربعات الأولى.
map_tab.not_ready: الخريطة ليست جاهزة بعد. ستظهر هنا بمجرد تشغيل الخادم ورندرة المربعات الأولى. جارٍ التحقق تلقائياً…
map_tab.enable_help: يثبت إصدار BlueMap المتوافق مع محمل هذا الخادم. يسري المفعول عند إعادة التشغيل القادمة.
map_tab.unsupported: لا يدعم BlueMap خوادم {flavor}. يتطلب محمل تعديلات (Fabric أو Forge أو NeoForge أو Quilt) أو خادم إضافات (عائلة Paper).
map_tab.installing_toast: جارٍ تثبيت BlueMap وتخصيص منفذ الخريطة…
map_tab.enabled_toast: تم تمكين الخريطة الحية. أعد تشغيل الخادم لتشغيلها.
map_tab.disabled_toast: تم تعطيل الخريطة الحية. يتم التطبيق عند إعادة التشغيل القادمة.
map_tab.disable_confirm_msg: يزيل BlueMap من هذا الخادم. تبقى لوحات الخريطة المعروضة على القرص حتى تحذفها من قسم الملفات.

bedrock_tab.packs_desc: تثبيت حزم السلوك والموارد لخادم بيدروك الأصلي. أعد تشغيل الخادم بعد التغيير.
bedrock_tab.no_packs_title: لا توجد حزم بيدروك مثبتة بعد
bedrock_tab.permissions_desc: إدارة قائمة السماح وصلاحيات كل لاعب عبر كونسول بيدروك.

integrations_tab.config_admin_only: التكوين وسجلات المحادثة مرئية للمسؤولين فقط.
integrations_tab.invocation_help: ينادي اللاعبون الروبوت بهذا الاسم، مثل @bubba. ويصبح أيضاً اسمه في الدردشة والسجلات.
integrations_tab.ollama_help: يعمل Ollama مع المضيف والمنفذ؛ وتتم إضافة /v1 تلقائياً. العناوين المحلية مدعومة.
integrations_tab.discovery_help: يقوم الاكتشاف بملء الاقتراحات؛ ويبقى الإدخال اليدوي متاحاً دائماً.
integrations_tab.retention_help: الافتراضي 7. عيّن 0 لعدم تخزين أي سجلات. تبقى السجلات الحالية حتى انتهاء هذه المدة.
integrations_tab.persona_help: يتم إرسال هذا كرسالة نظام لهذا الخادم. تُمنح الصلاحيات كأدوات محددة ومتحقق منها وليست أوامر وحدة تحكم خام.
integrations_tab.outreach_help: تحيات ورسائل تفقدية محددة لكل جلسة دون الحاجة لطلب نموذج الذكاء الاصطناعي.
integrations_tab.join_greeting_help: تُبث مرة واحدة عند انضمام لاعب. المتغيرات: {player} و {chatbot} و {mention}. المتغير القديم {wizard} لا يزال مدعوماً.
integrations_tab.checkin_help: تُرسل مرة واحدة لكل جلسة لعب. عيّن 0 للتعطيل. يمكن للرسالة استخدام {minutes} أيضاً.

MEMORY.label: RAM (Java heap)
MEMORY.help: Memory the Minecraft/Java process may use. The image hands this to Java as both the starting and the maximum heap, so a running server settles at this figure within its first minute and stays there even when nobody is playing. That is Java keeping what it was given, not a leak. Modpacks usually need 4 GB or more; the image default of 1 GB is only enough for small vanilla servers.

INIT_MEMORY.label: Initial heap (advanced)
INIT_MEMORY.help: Sets a smaller starting heap than the maximum, so memory use grows with the world instead of sitting at the full heap from the start. Measured on a 2 GB heap: 512 MB here brought idle use from 2.6 GB down to about 1.3 GB. Leave empty to let "RAM (Java heap)" control both, which is what Aikar’s flags recommend for the steadiest performance.

MAX_MEMORY.label: Maximum heap (advanced)
MAX_MEMORY.help: Sets a different maximum heap than the initial one. Leave empty to let "RAM (Java heap)" control both.

memory.label: Container memory limit
memory.help: The hard memory limit Docker enforces on the whole container. Keep it 25 to 50 percent above the Java heap: Java needs extra room beyond the heap, and if the server reaches this limit it is stopped instantly for running out of memory.

memorySwap.label: Container swap limit
memorySwap.help: Extra swap space the container may use beyond its memory limit. 0 disables swap. Swapping a Minecraft server causes heavy lag, so leave it at 0 unless you know you need it.

cpus.label: CPU limit
cpus.help: How many host CPU cores the server may use (Docker NanoCpus). 0 means unlimited. When a server hits its cap it slows down (tick lag) rather than being killed.

diskQuotaGb.label: Disk quota
diskQuotaGb.help: A limit on this server’s folder size, enforced by the panel itself, since Docker cannot limit disk use for this kind of storage. Over quota, actions that would grow the disk, like mod installs and backups, are blocked until space is freed.

quotaStrict.label: Strict quota mode
quotaStrict.help: When usage exceeds the quota by more than 10%, gracefully stop the server automatically. Protects the host from runaway world or log growth; the stop is recorded in history.

USE_AIKAR_FLAGS.label: Aikar’s optimization flags
USE_AIKAR_FLAGS.help: Battle-tested Java garbage-collection tuning that reduces lag spikes on busy servers. Recommended for most servers with 4 GB of RAM or more. Reserves the whole heap the moment the server starts, so memory reads as the full "RAM (Java heap)" value immediately (it would reach that figure within a minute anyway).

USE_MEOWICE_FLAGS.label: MeowIce’s flags (Java 17+)
USE_MEOWICE_FLAGS.help: A newer alternative to Aikar’s flags tuned for modern Java versions. Pick either this or Aikar’s flags, not both. Like Aikar’s, it reserves the whole heap the moment the server starts.

JVM_OPTS.label: Extra JVM options
JVM_OPTS.help: Additional options passed straight to the Java command line, space-separated (for example -XX:+UseZGC). These come after the flag presets, so they win over them; -XX:-AlwaysPreTouch here stops Aikar’s or MeowIce’s flags from reserving the whole heap at start. For -X options use the dedicated field below.

JVM_XX_OPTS.label: JVM -XX options
JVM_XX_OPTS.help: Options placed before the memory flags, typically -XX garbage-collector settings. Note that the flag presets are added after these, so a preset’s own setting wins over a conflicting one here; use "Extra JVM options" to override a preset.

JVM_DD_OPTS.label: JVM system properties (-D)
JVM_DD_OPTS.help: Comma or space separated name=value pairs turned into -Dname=value system properties. Example: disable.watchdog:true is needed for auto-pause on Paper servers.

ENABLE_JMX.label: JMX monitoring
ENABLE_JMX.help: Opens a JMX port for attaching Java profilers like VisualVM from another machine. Requires JMX_HOST to be set to the Docker host’s IP.

TYPE.label: Server type
TYPE.help: Which server platform to install and run. Changing this re-installs the server files on the next start; your world data is kept, but mods and plugins only work on matching types.

VERSION.label: Minecraft version
VERSION.help: The Minecraft version to install, e.g. 1.20.4, or LATEST / SNAPSHOT to track a channel. With LATEST or SNAPSHOT, restarting the server upgrades it when a newer version is out.

EULA.label: Mojang EULA accepted
EULA.help: The server refuses to start until Mojang’s End User License Agreement is accepted. The panel sets this automatically after you accept the EULA in the creation wizard.

PAPER_BUILD.label: Paper build
PAPER_BUILD.help: Pins a specific PaperMC build number instead of the latest one for the chosen Minecraft version. Leave empty for the latest build.

PAPER_CHANNEL.label: Paper release channel
PAPER_CHANNEL.help: Which PaperMC channel to download from. If a brand-new Minecraft version fails with "No build found ... with channel 'default'", switch to experimental.

PURPUR_BUILD.label: Purpur build
PURPUR_BUILD.help: Pins a specific Purpur build for the chosen Minecraft version. Leave at LATEST unless you need to roll back a broken build.

FORGE_VERSION.label: Forge version
FORGE_VERSION.help: The Forge loader version, e.g. 14.23.5.2854 or "latest". When empty, the recommended Forge version for your Minecraft version is used.

NEOFORGE_VERSION.label: NeoForge version
NEOFORGE_VERSION.help: The NeoForge loader version: a specific version, "latest", or "beta". When empty, the latest non-beta version for your Minecraft version is used.

FABRIC_LOADER_VERSION.label: Fabric loader version
FABRIC_LOADER_VERSION.help: Pins a specific Fabric loader version. Leave empty for the latest; most mods also need the Fabric API mod installed separately.

FABRIC_LAUNCHER_VERSION.label: Fabric launcher version
FABRIC_LAUNCHER_VERSION.help: Pins a specific version of the Fabric server launcher itself. Rarely needed. Leave it empty for the latest.

QUILT_LOADER_VERSION.label: Quilt loader version
QUILT_LOADER_VERSION.help: Pins a specific Quilt loader version. Leave empty for the latest.

CUSTOM_SERVER.label: Custom server JAR
CUSTOM_SERVER.help: URL or container path of the server jar when the type is Custom. A URL is only downloaded once. To fetch a new copy, delete the jar from the server folder and restart.

javaTag.label: Java version (image tag)
javaTag.help: Which Java runtime image the server runs on. Auto picks the right one for your Minecraft version, and for GT New Horizons, the newest Java the pinned pack version supports. Override only for special cases like old Forge (needs Java 8) or mods that break on newer Java. Forcing a GTNH server to Java 8 makes the image install GTNH’s legacy Java 8 server pack instead of the faster lwjgl3ify one.

TZ.label: Time zone
TZ.help: IANA time zone name (for example, Europe/London) so log timestamps and scheduled tasks match your local time. Defaults to UTC.

UID.label: File owner user ID
UID.help: Linux user ID the server process runs as. The panel sets this to its own user automatically so it can manage the server’s files (mods, backups, deletes); on Linux a value here is overridden. Only relevant on hosts that must pin a specific owner.

GID.label: File owner group ID
GID.help: Linux group ID the server process runs as. Pairs with the user ID above.

SETUP_ONLY.label: Setup only (no launch)
SETUP_ONLY.help: Downloads and installs all server files, then exits without starting the server. Useful for pre-provisioning a data directory; the container stops right after setup.

LEVEL.label: World save name
LEVEL.help: Name of the world save directory inside the server folder. Change it to switch between saves. The old world stays on disk under its own name.

SEED.label: World seed
SEED.help: Seed used when generating a new world. Only affects worlds that have not been created yet. It does nothing to an existing world.

LEVEL_TYPE.label: World type
LEVEL_TYPE.help: World generator preset used when a new world is created. Pair Superflat with generator settings below to customize the layers.

GENERATOR_SETTINGS.label: Generator settings (JSON)
GENERATOR_SETTINGS.help: JSON options that customize world generation for certain world types. For Superflat, this is the layer list and biome. Layers apply bottom-up from Y=-64.

WORLD.label: World download URL / path
WORLD.help: URL of a zip/tar archive (or a container path) containing an existing world to import. It is only copied in if the world does not already exist. See "Force world copy" to overwrite.

FORCE_WORLD_COPY.label: Force world copy
FORCE_WORLD_COPY.help: Re-copies the imported world over the existing one on every start. Leaving this on permanently wipes player progress at each restart. Enable it once to reset, then turn it back off.

SPAWN_PROTECTION.label: Spawn protection radius
SPAWN_PROTECTION.help: Radius in blocks around spawn that only operators can modify. 0 disables protection; the vanilla default is 16.

VIEW_DISTANCE.label: View distance
VIEW_DISTANCE.help: How many chunks around each player the server sends to their client (vanilla default 10). One of the biggest levers for RAM, CPU, and bandwidth. Lower it if the server lags.

SIMULATION_DISTANCE.label: Simulation distance
SIMULATION_DISTANCE.help: How many chunks around each player actually tick: mobs, crops, machines (vanilla default 10). A big performance lever alongside view distance.

MAX_WORLD_SIZE.label: World border radius
MAX_WORLD_SIZE.help: Maximum world border radius in blocks (vanilla default 29,999,984). Useful to cap disk usage from exploration.

ALLOW_NETHER.label: Allow the Nether
ALLOW_NETHER.help: Lets players travel to the Nether dimension through portals.

GENERATE_STRUCTURES.label: Generate structures
GENERATE_STRUCTURES.help: Generates villages, strongholds, and other structures in new chunks.

SPAWN_ANIMALS.label: Spawn animals
SPAWN_ANIMALS.help: Lets passive animals spawn naturally. Recent Minecraft versions moved this to a gamerule and no longer read this property.

SPAWN_MONSTERS.label: Spawn monsters
SPAWN_MONSTERS.help: Lets hostile mobs spawn naturally at night and in the dark.

SPAWN_NPCS.label: Spawn villagers
SPAWN_NPCS.help: Lets villagers spawn. Recent Minecraft versions no longer read this property.

HARDCORE.label: Hardcore mode
HARDCORE.help: On death, players are switched to spectator mode instead of respawning. Difficulty is locked to hard.

ENABLE_COMMAND_BLOCK.label: Enable command blocks
ENABLE_COMMAND_BLOCK.help: Allows command blocks to run their commands. Required by many adventure maps and some datapacks.

DIFFICULTY.label: Difficulty
DIFFICULTY.help: How hard the game is: mob damage, hunger, and hostile spawns. Peaceful removes hostile mobs entirely.

MODE.label: Game mode
MODE.help: The default game mode new players start in. Spectator requires Minecraft 1.8 or newer.

MOTD.label: Server list message (MOTD)
MOTD.help: The text shown under your server in the multiplayer server list. Supports color/formatting codes via § and multiple lines with \n; if empty, a default based on server type and version is used.

MAX_PLAYERS.label: Max players
MAX_PLAYERS.help: Maximum number of players that can be online at once (vanilla default 20).

PVP.label: PvP
PVP.help: Lets players damage each other (vanilla default on).

ALLOW_FLIGHT.label: Allow flight
ALLOW_FLIGHT.help: Stops the server kicking players who appear to fly in survival mode. Needed for mods that add flight (jetpacks, etc.); leaving it off also catches some fly-hack cheats.

ONLINE_MODE.label: Online mode (Mojang auth)
ONLINE_MODE.help: Verifies every player against Mojang’s authentication servers (vanilla default on). Turning it off lets anyone join with any name, including pirated clients. This is a serious security risk unless you run behind a proxy that handles authentication.

FORCE_GAMEMODE.label: Force game mode on join
FORCE_GAMEMODE.help: Players are switched back to the server’s default game mode every time they rejoin, instead of keeping whatever mode they had.

PLAYER_IDLE_TIMEOUT.label: Idle kick timeout
PLAYER_IDLE_TIMEOUT.help: Kick players after this many minutes of inactivity (vanilla default 0 = never kick).

RESOURCE_PACK.label: Resource pack URL
RESOURCE_PACK.help: Direct-download URL of a resource pack (.zip) that clients are prompted to use when joining.

RESOURCE_PACK_SHA1.label: Resource pack SHA-1
RESOURCE_PACK_SHA1.help: SHA-1 checksum (40 hex characters) of the resource pack so clients can verify and cache it. Update it whenever the pack file changes, or clients keep using the old cached copy.

RESOURCE_PACK_ENFORCE.label: Require resource pack
RESOURCE_PACK_ENFORCE.help: Players who decline the resource pack are not allowed to join.

OP_PERMISSION_LEVEL.label: Operator permission level
OP_PERMISSION_LEVEL.help: Default power level granted to operators, 1 (bypass spawn protection) to 4 (all commands including /stop). Vanilla default is 4.

FUNCTION_PERMISSION_LEVEL.label: Datapack function permission level
FUNCTION_PERMISSION_LEVEL.help: Permission level (1 to 4) that datapack functions run with. Raise it only if a datapack needs privileged commands.

WHITELIST.label: Whitelisted players
WHITELIST.help: Player names (or UUIDs) allowed to join. Setting any names automatically turns whitelisting on; names are resolved to UUIDs via a player-lookup API at startup.

WHITELIST_FILE.label: Whitelist file URL / path
WHITELIST_FILE.help: URL or container path of a whitelist.json to install. Cannot be combined with the MERGE mode below; by default it replaces the existing file and then the player list above is merged in.

EXISTING_WHITELIST_FILE.label: Existing whitelist handling
EXISTING_WHITELIST_FILE.help: What to do when a whitelist file already exists on the server: leave it alone, overwrite it to match your settings, or merge new players into it.

ENFORCE_WHITELIST.label: Enforce whitelist changes
ENFORCE_WHITELIST.help: Immediately kicks online players who are removed from the whitelist, instead of waiting until they reconnect.

ENABLE_WHITELIST.label: Whitelist on (manual file)
ENABLE_WHITELIST.help: Turns whitelisting on when you manage the whitelist file yourself. Not needed if you list players above, which enables the whitelist automatically.

OPS.label: Operators (admins)
OPS.help: Player names (or UUIDs) given operator/admin rights at startup. Operators can run server commands in-game, so grant this sparingly.

OPS_FILE.label: Ops file URL / path
OPS_FILE.help: URL or container path of an ops.json to install into the standard location. Cannot be combined with the MERGE mode below.

EXISTING_OPS_FILE.label: Existing ops handling
EXISTING_OPS_FILE.help: What to do when an ops file already exists: leave it, overwrite it to match your settings (existing permission levels are kept), or merge new operators into it.

SERVER_PORT.label: In-container game port
SERVER_PORT.help: The port the server binds inside the container. The docs warn that changing it breaks image integrations, so the panel keeps it at 25565 and maps a host port instead.

portGame.label: Game port (on this machine)
portGame.help: The host port players connect to; the panel maps it to the container’s internal game port (25565). A free port is suggested automatically, and each server needs its own.

portRcon.label: RCON port (on this machine)
portRcon.help: Host port the panel maps to the container’s RCON port (25575) so it can send commands and stop the server gracefully. Keep it firewalled from the internet: RCON grants full console access.

portBedrock.label: Bedrock port (on this machine)
portBedrock.help: UDP host port mapped for Bedrock clients when a GeyserMC bridge is installed (in-container 19132/udp). Leave empty if you only serve Java Edition players.

ENABLE_QUERY.label: Query protocol
ENABLE_QUERY.help: Enables the GameSpy query protocol so external tools can ask the server for its status and player list. Note: off-box queries hit the game port and will wake an auto-paused server.

QUERY_PORT.label: Query port (UDP)
QUERY_PORT.help: UDP port used by the query protocol inside the container (default 25565). Only relevant when the query protocol is enabled.

PREVENT_PROXY_CONNECTIONS.label: Block VPN/proxy players
PREVENT_PROXY_CONNECTIONS.help: Kicks players whose connection appears to come through a VPN or proxy.

NETWORK_COMPRESSION_THRESHOLD.label: Packet compression threshold
NETWORK_COMPRESSION_THRESHOLD.help: Packets larger than this many bytes are compressed before sending (vanilla default 256). Use -1 to disable compression or 0 to compress everything. Lower values trade CPU for bandwidth.

USE_NATIVE_TRANSPORT.label: Native network transport
USE_NATIVE_TRANSPORT.help: Uses Linux-optimized (epoll) networking for better throughput (vanilla default on). Only turn off to troubleshoot networking issues.

ENABLE_RCON.label: RCON enabled
ENABLE_RCON.help: The remote-console protocol used for graceful shutdown, backups, and the interactive console. The panel needs it to stop the server cleanly and send commands, so leave it on.
ENABLE_RCON.note: Required for panel commands & graceful stop

RCON_PASSWORD.label: RCON password
RCON_PASSWORD.help: Authentication password for RCON. If unset, the image generates a new random one on every start, so the panel generates a secure password once and stores it itself.

RCON_PORT.label: In-container RCON port
RCON_PORT.help: Port the server listens on for RCON inside the container. The docs warn that changing it breaks the image’s graceful-stop and health checks, so the panel keeps it at 25575.

BROADCAST_RCON_TO_OPS.label: Show RCON output to ops
BROADCAST_RCON_TO_OPS.help: Broadcasts the output of RCON-issued commands to online operators. With a panel sending frequent commands, leaving this off avoids chat spam for your ops.

RCON_CMDS_STARTUP.label: Commands on server start
RCON_CMDS_STARTUP.help: Console commands run automatically each time the server starts, one per line. Handy for setting gamerules. The leading / is optional.

RCON_CMDS_ON_CONNECT.label: Commands when a player joins
RCON_CMDS_ON_CONNECT.help: Console commands run whenever any player connects, one per line. The hook doesn’t know who joined, so use selector-based commands like @a[team=] to target players.

RCON_CMDS_FIRST_CONNECT.label: Commands when server becomes occupied
RCON_CMDS_FIRST_CONNECT.help: Console commands run when the first player joins an empty server. For example, pausing chunk pre-generation while people are online.

RCON_CMDS_ON_DISCONNECT.label: Commands when a player leaves
RCON_CMDS_ON_DISCONNECT.help: Console commands run whenever any player disconnects, one per line.

RCON_CMDS_LAST_DISCONNECT.label: Commands when server becomes empty
RCON_CMDS_LAST_DISCONNECT.help: Console commands run when the last player leaves. For example, cleaning up dropped items or resuming chunk pre-generation.

CREATE_CONSOLE_IN_PIPE.label: Console input pipe
CREATE_CONSOLE_IN_PIPE.help: Creates a stdin pipe so console commands can still be sent (via mc-send-to-console) when RCON is disabled. Only needed as a fallback.

CF_API_KEY.label: CurseForge API key
CF_API_KEY.help: Personal API key from console.curseforge.com, required for automated CurseForge modpack installs. Stored once in the panel settings and injected automatically.

CF_SLUG.label: CurseForge modpack slug
CF_SLUG.help: The modpack’s slug identifier (e.g. craftoria). Managed by the modpack installer UI.
CF_SLUG.note: Managed by the modpack installer UI

CF_PAGE_URL.label: CurseForge modpack page URL
CF_PAGE_URL.help: URL of the modpack page (or a specific file page) on curseforge.com. Managed by the modpack installer UI.
CF_PAGE_URL.note: Managed by the modpack installer UI

CF_FILE_ID.label: CurseForge file ID
CF_FILE_ID.help: Numeric file ID that pins a specific modpack version instead of the latest. Managed by the modpack installer UI.
CF_FILE_ID.note: Managed by the modpack installer UI

CF_FILENAME_MATCHER.label: CurseForge filename matcher
CF_FILENAME_MATCHER.help: Substring used to pick the desired modpack file by name. Managed by the modpack installer UI.
CF_FILENAME_MATCHER.note: Managed by the modpack installer UI

CF_EXCLUDE_MODS.label: Exclude mods
CF_EXCLUDE_MODS.help: Mods (project slugs or IDs) to skip when installing the modpack. These are typically client-only mods that crash a dedicated server.

CF_FORCE_INCLUDE_MODS.label: Force-include mods
CF_FORCE_INCLUDE_MODS.help: Mods (slugs or IDs) to install even if an exclusion rule would normally skip them.

CF_EXCLUDE_ALL_MODS.label: Exclude all mods
CF_EXCLUDE_ALL_MODS.help: Skips installing every mod from the pack; combine with force-include to hand-pick only the mods you want.

CF_OVERRIDES_EXCLUSIONS.label: Exclude override files
CF_OVERRIDES_EXCLUSIONS.help: Ant-style path patterns for files in the modpack’s overrides that should not be copied onto the server.

CF_IGNORE_MISSING_FILES.label: Ignore missing pack files
CF_IGNORE_MISSING_FILES.help: Continues the install even when some files listed by the modpack can’t be downloaded, instead of failing the whole startup.

CF_FORCE_SYNCHRONIZE.label: Re-apply exclude/include rules
CF_FORCE_SYNCHRONIZE.help: Forces the exclusion and inclusion rules to be re-evaluated on the next start. Use it after changing the lists above.

CF_PARALLEL_DOWNLOADS.label: Parallel mod downloads
CF_PARALLEL_DOWNLOADS.help: How many mod files are downloaded at the same time during a modpack install.

CF_SET_LEVEL_FROM.label: Use modpack world
CF_SET_LEVEL_FROM.help: Automatically points the server at world data shipped inside the modpack, either a bundled world file or the pack’s overrides folder.

MODRINTH_MODPACK.label: Modrinth modpack
MODRINTH_MODPACK.help: Modrinth project slug, ID, page URL, or .mrpack path/URL to install. Managed by the modpack installer UI.
MODRINTH_MODPACK.note: Managed by the modpack installer UI

MODRINTH_VERSION.label: Modrinth modpack version
MODRINTH_VERSION.help: Version ID or number that pins a specific modpack release. Managed by the modpack installer UI.
MODRINTH_VERSION.note: Managed by the modpack installer UI

MODRINTH_MODPACK_VERSION_TYPE.label: Modrinth release channel
MODRINTH_MODPACK_VERSION_TYPE.help: Which release channel to accept when resolving the latest modpack version: stable releases only, or also beta/alpha builds.

MODRINTH_EXCLUDE_FILES.label: Exclude pack files
MODRINTH_EXCLUDE_FILES.help: Files from the Modrinth pack to skip installing. These are typically client-only mods that crash a dedicated server.

MODRINTH_FORCE_INCLUDE_FILES.label: Force-include pack files
MODRINTH_FORCE_INCLUDE_FILES.help: Files to install even if an exclusion rule would normally skip them.

MODRINTH_IGNORE_MISSING_FILES.label: Ignore missing pack files
MODRINTH_IGNORE_MISSING_FILES.help: Continues the install even when some files listed by the pack can’t be downloaded.

MODRINTH_FORCE_SYNCHRONIZE.label: Re-apply exclude/include rules
MODRINTH_FORCE_SYNCHRONIZE.help: Forces the Modrinth exclusion and inclusion rules to be re-evaluated on the next start.

MODRINTH_PROJECTS.label: Individual Modrinth mods/plugins
MODRINTH_PROJECTS.help: Modrinth projects to download individually, outside any modpack, for example fabric-api. One slug or ID per line.

FTB_MODPACK_ID.label: FTB modpack ID
FTB_MODPACK_ID.help: Numeric Feed the Beast modpack ID. Managed by the modpack installer UI.
FTB_MODPACK_ID.note: Managed by the modpack installer UI

FTB_MODPACK_VERSION_ID.label: FTB modpack version ID
FTB_MODPACK_VERSION_ID.help: Pins a specific FTB pack version; latest when unset. Managed by the modpack installer UI.
FTB_MODPACK_VERSION_ID.note: Managed by the modpack installer UI

CURSEFORGE_FILES.label: Individual CurseForge files
CURSEFORGE_FILES.help: Individual CurseForge mods or plugins to download outside a modpack, one reference per line. Requires the CurseForge API key.

MODS.label: Mod downloads
MODS.help: Mod jars to install: URLs, container paths, or directories of jars, one per line. Entries removed from this list are also removed from disk. An empty list deletes all managed mods.

PLUGINS.label: Plugin downloads
PLUGINS.help: Plugin jars to install on Paper/Spigot-family servers: URLs, container paths, or directories, one per line. Entries removed from the list are removed from disk too.

MODS_FILE.label: Mods list file
MODS_FILE.help: URL or container path of a text file listing one mod URL per line (# comments allowed). Useful for sharing one mod list across servers.

SPIGET_RESOURCES.label: Spigot plugins (Spiget IDs)
SPIGET_RESOURCES.help: SpigotMC resource IDs to auto-download as plugins via the Spiget API. Only the numeric ID from the plugin’s page URL is needed.

GENERIC_PACK.label: Generic content pack
GENERIC_PACK.help: URL or container path of a zip/tgz containing arbitrary server content (mods, plugins, configs) to unpack over the server folder. Also handy for CurseForge packs without an installer.

GENERIC_PACKS.label: Generic content packs (multiple)
GENERIC_PACKS.help: Several archives applied in order, comma separated. The prefix and suffix fields below are added around each entry. Useful for building CDN URLs.

GENERIC_PACKS_PREFIX.label: Generic packs URL prefix
GENERIC_PACKS_PREFIX.help: Text prepended to every entry in the generic packs list, e.g. a base URL.

GENERIC_PACKS_SUFFIX.label: Generic packs URL suffix
GENERIC_PACKS_SUFFIX.help: Text appended to every entry in the generic packs list, e.g. ".zip".

DATAPACKS.label: Datapacks
DATAPACKS.help: Datapack zips to install into the world’s datapacks folder: URLs, container paths, or directories, one per line.

VANILLATWEAKS_SHARECODE.label: VanillaTweaks share codes
VANILLATWEAKS_SHARECODE.help: Share codes from vanillatweaks.net whose datapacks and crafting tweaks are installed into the world automatically. Old versions are cleaned up on update.

VANILLATWEAKS_FILE.label: VanillaTweaks spec file
VANILLATWEAKS_FILE.help: Container path or URL of a VanillaTweaks JSON spec file, as an alternative to share codes.

GTNH_PACK_VERSION.label: GTNH pack version
GTNH_PACK_VERSION.help: The exact GT New Horizons release to install. Managed by the modpack installer. The panel always pins a concrete version so restarts never upgrade the pack behind your back.
GTNH_PACK_VERSION.note: Managed by the modpack installer UI

SKIP_GTNH_UPDATE_CHECK.label: Skip the image’s GTNH update check
SKIP_GTNH_UPDATE_CHECK.help: Stops the container comparing the installed pack against GTNH_PACK_VERSION on boot. Leave off: the check also runs the installer, so skipping it on a server whose pack has not installed yet means the pack never downloads and the server crash-loops on missing files. The pinned version already prevents surprise upgrades.

GTNH_DELETE_BACKUPS.label: Delete GTNH’s own backups on update
GTNH_DELETE_BACKUPS.help: Removes the backup copies the GTNH updater leaves behind in the server folder. The panel takes its own backups before any pack upgrade, so this mainly saves disk.

REMOVE_OLD_MODS.label: Wipe mods before install
REMOVE_OLD_MODS.help: Deletes the entire mods (or plugins) folder before installing new content. The panel never sets this: it wipes the whole mods folder, including anything added by hand.
REMOVE_OLD_MODS.note: Never set by the panel. Wipes the whole mods folder.

ENABLE_AUTOPAUSE.label: Auto-pause when empty
ENABLE_AUTOPAUSE.help: Freezes the Java process after the server has been idle, and wakes it the moment someone tries to connect. Requires the tick watchdog to be disabled (Max tick time = -1) or the server may be killed on resume.

AUTOPAUSE_TIMEOUT_EST.label: Pause after last player leaves
AUTOPAUSE_TIMEOUT_EST.help: Seconds to wait after the last player disconnects before pausing.

AUTOPAUSE_TIMEOUT_INIT.label: Pause after start (no players)
AUTOPAUSE_TIMEOUT_INIT.help: Seconds to wait after server start before pausing if nobody has connected at all.

AUTOPAUSE_TIMEOUT_KN.label: Pause after port knock
AUTOPAUSE_TIMEOUT_KN.help: Seconds to wait after a connection attempt (like a server-list ping) before pausing again if no player actually joins. Note: any external ping, including uptime monitors, wakes a paused server.

AUTOPAUSE_PERIOD.label: Pause check interval
AUTOPAUSE_PERIOD.help: How often, in seconds, the pause state machine checks whether it should pause. Waking up is instant and knock-driven, not tied to this interval.

AUTOPAUSE_KNOCK_INTERFACE.label: Knock network interface
AUTOPAUSE_KNOCK_INTERFACE.help: Network interface watched for incoming connection attempts. Only change with host networking or unusual setups. The interface must exist inside the container, and "lo" does not work.

AUTOPAUSE_STATUS_RETRY_LIMIT.label: Status retry limit
AUTOPAUSE_STATUS_RETRY_LIMIT.help: How many times the pause monitor retries reading the server status before giving up.

DEBUG_AUTOPAUSE.label: Auto-pause debug logging
DEBUG_AUTOPAUSE.help: Verbose logging of the auto-pause state machine, for troubleshooting why the server does or does not pause.

MAX_TICK_TIME.label: Max tick time (watchdog)
MAX_TICK_TIME.help: Milliseconds a single tick may take before the watchdog kills the server (vanilla default 60000). Must be -1 (disabled) for auto-pause, since a paused tick looks endless to the watchdog. It is also common for heavy modpacks.

ENABLE_AUTOSTOP.label: Auto-stop when empty
ENABLE_AUTOSTOP.help: Shuts the server down entirely (the container exits) after being idle. Unlike auto-pause, it does not wake automatically. You start it again from the panel. Do not combine it with auto-pause.

AUTOSTOP_TIMEOUT_EST.label: Stop after last player leaves
AUTOSTOP_TIMEOUT_EST.help: Seconds to wait after the last player disconnects before stopping the server.

AUTOSTOP_TIMEOUT_INIT.label: Stop after start (no players)
AUTOSTOP_TIMEOUT_INIT.help: Seconds to wait after server start before stopping if nobody has connected at all.

AUTOSTOP_PERIOD.label: Stop check interval
AUTOSTOP_PERIOD.help: How often, in seconds, the auto-stop state machine checks whether it should stop the server.

DEBUG_AUTOSTOP.label: Auto-stop debug logging
DEBUG_AUTOSTOP.help: Verbose logging of the auto-stop state machine.

PAUSE_WHEN_EMPTY_SECONDS.label: Native pause when empty (1.21.2+)
PAUSE_WHEN_EMPTY_SECONDS.help: Minecraft’s built-in pause: the game loop stops after the server has been empty this many seconds. On modern versions this is the recommended, simpler alternative to the container-level auto-pause above.

STOP_DURATION.label: Graceful stop timeout
STOP_DURATION.help: Seconds to wait for the server to save and exit after "stop" is sent. Raise it together with the Docker stop grace period. If the server is force-killed before it finishes saving, give it more time here.

STOP_SERVER_ANNOUNCE_DELAY.label: Shutdown announce delay
STOP_SERVER_ANNOUNCE_DELAY.help: Seconds between announcing the shutdown in-game and actually stopping, so players can wrap up. The Docker stop grace period must be longer than this delay plus save time.

ENABLE_ROLLING_LOGS.label: Rolling log files (legacy)
ENABLE_ROLLING_LOGS.help: Legacy switch. Rolling and archived log files are now on by default through the templated logging config. Only relevant for old Minecraft versions where rolling logs conflict with Log4j security patches.

LOG_TIMESTAMP.label: Timestamp startup logs
LOG_TIMESTAMP.help: Prefixes the container’s [init] startup log lines with a timestamp. Affects only the image’s setup logs, not the Minecraft server’s own log output.

SNOOPER_ENABLED.label: Mojang telemetry (snooper)
SNOOPER_ENABLED.help: Sends usage telemetry to Mojang. This only exists on older Minecraft versions; it was removed in modern ones.

DUMP_SERVER_PROPERTIES.label: Dump server.properties to log
DUMP_SERVER_PROPERTIES.help: Prints the final server.properties contents to the log before the server starts. Handy for debugging why a setting didn’t apply.

DEBUG.label: Verbose startup debug
DEBUG.help: Much more verbose logging of the container’s startup scripts (downloads and installs), not the Minecraft server itself. Turn on when reporting problems.

OVERRIDE_SERVER_PROPERTIES.label: Panel manages server.properties
OVERRIDE_SERVER_PROPERTIES.help: When on (default), server.properties is rewritten from these settings at every start. Turn off only if you want to hand-edit the file. Panel property settings then stop applying.

SKIP_SERVER_PROPERTIES.label: Skip server.properties entirely
SKIP_SERVER_PROPERTIES.help: Stops the image from creating or touching server.properties at all. This is stronger than the override toggle above; no file is created if it’s missing. Leave off unless something else fully manages the file.

SERVER_NAME.label: Server name
SERVER_NAME.help: Name shown to Bedrock players in the server list.

GAMEMODE.label: Game mode
GAMEMODE.help: Default game mode for new players.

DEFAULT_PLAYER_PERMISSION_LEVEL.label: Default player permission
DEFAULT_PLAYER_PERMISSION_LEVEL.help: Permission level assigned to new players.

LEVEL_NAME.label: World name
LEVEL_NAME.help: Name of the Bedrock world folder.

LEVEL_SEED.label: World seed
LEVEL_SEED.help: Seed used only when creating a new world.

TICK_DISTANCE.label: Tick distance
TICK_DISTANCE.help: Chunks that actively simulate around each player.

TEXTUREPACK_REQUIRED.label: Require resource packs
TEXTUREPACK_REQUIRED.help: Prevents players joining until they download required resource packs.

ALLOW_LIST.label: Allow list
ALLOW_LIST.help: Restricts joining to players on the Bedrock allow list.

ENABLE_LAN_VISIBILITY.label: LAN visibility
ENABLE_LAN_VISIBILITY.help: Advertises the server to Bedrock clients on the local network.

COMPRESSION_THRESHOLD.label: Compression threshold
COMPRESSION_THRESHOLD.help: Packets at or above this size are compressed. 0 compresses every packet.

view.label: عرض
view.help: عرض الخادم وحالته وإخراج وحدة التحكم واللاعبين والسجل والإحصاءات.

power.label: الطاقة
power.help: بدء الخادم وإيقافه وإعادة تشغيله وفرض الإيقاف وإعادة بنائه.

console.label: وحدة التحكم
console.help: تشغيل أوامر وحدة التحكم وإجراءات العالم السريعة وإرسال الدردشة وإدارة الأوامر.

players.label: اللاعبون
players.help: إدارة المشرفين والقائمة البيضاء والحظر والطرد وفحص مخزون اللاعبين.

content.label: المحتوى
content.help: تثبيت وتحديث وتمكين وإزالة التعديلات والإضافات وحزم التعديل والعوالم.

backups.label: النسخ الاحتياطية
backups.help: إنشاء واستعادة وإعادة تسمية وتنزيل وحذف النسخ الاحتياطية للخادم.

files.label: الملفات
files.help: استعراض وتعديل ورفع وتنزيل ملفات الخادم وسجلاته وحزمها وتصدير المخططات.

settings.label: الإعدادات
settings.help: تغيير إعدادات الخادم وخصائصه والتكاملات والأيقونة وترقية الإصدارات.
